name: What causes bathroom door frames to rot or warp?

mainEntity.name: What causes bathroom door frames to rot or warp?

acceptedAnswer.text: Water damage from showers, steam, and standing floor water is the most common cause of bathroom door frame deterioration. Moisture seeps into the bottom of the jamb and casing, leading to swelling, peeling paint, rot, and mold. Other frequent issues include house settling, which throws the frame out of square, and loose hinge screws stripped from frequent door use. When diagnosing the issue, checking whether the subfloor beneath the jamb is soft helps determine if water has penetrated beyond the trim into the structural framing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom door frames typically warp or rot due to excess shower steam, leaks, or standing water soaking into the wood base, as well as natural house settling.
